changeSet.createProcedure: create view aur_vw_depo_stok_adres (id, urunadresid, stokkodu, lastupdatedate, lastupdateuser, depocode, miktar, barcode, adres, status, companycode, stockname) as SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY aduas.stok_kod) AS id, aduas.urun_adres_id AS urunadresid, aduas.stok_kod AS stokkodu, aduas.last_modified_date AS lastupdatedate, aduas.last_modified_by AS lastupdateuser, aduas.depo_code AS depocode, aduas.miktar, aduas.barcode, adua.adres, aduas.status, aduas.company_code AS companycode, pr.stok_adi AS stockname FROM aur_depo_urun_adres_stok aduas JOIN aur_depo_urun_adres adua ON aduas.urun_adres_id = adua.id LEFT JOIN product pr ON aduas.barcode = pr.barkod and aduas.company_code = pr.company_code;
